Are you experienced within information security, compliance and risk management? Do you enjoy turning requirements into practical processes and controls? Then you might be the person we’re looking for as our new Information Security & Compliance Manager.

Loyalty Key is a Nordic leader in the development and operation of digital loyalty solutions for the financial sector. We work with leading partners and clients to build secure, scalable loyalty platforms and services.

As our business and products continue to grow, information security and compliance are becoming increasingly important. We are therefore looking for someone who can take ownership of our security and compliance framework, help maintain our existing assurance setup and support us as we strengthen our compliance capabilities further.

You will work closely with management, IT and other teams across the organisation. The role will include coordinating audits, maintaining policies and controls, supporting risk assessments, following up on findings and helping ensure that security and compliance requirements are embedded in the way we work.

We are looking for someone who is structured, pragmatic and proactive. You should be comfortable working independently, but also enjoy collaborating with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You’ll be part of an ambitious team of 45 people, headquartered between Østerport and Nordhavn station. We work towards the same goal: staying ahead of customer needs and executing on them. We have an informal atmosphere, short decision-making paths and a culture where people are encouraged to take responsibility and make an impact.

It is a requirement that you have a residence and work permit in Denmark.

We are looking for someone with experience within information security, compliance, IT risk, audit or a related field.

You will work closely with our IT team, who are responsible for the technical implementation of security measures, while you will own and coordinate the governance, risk and compliance activities.

Your responsibilities will include

• 
Maintaining and developing our information security and compliance framework.

• 
Coordinating audits and maintaining relevant documentation and evidence.

• 
Supporting existing assurance requirements and future security and compliance certifications.

• 
Performing and following up on risk assessments and control activities.

• 
Maintaining security and compliance policies and procedures.

• 
Supporting supplier and third-party security assessments.

• 
Supporting customer security and compliance requests.

• 
Working closely with IT and other teams to ensure requirements are implemented in practice.

• 
Reporting relevant risks, findings and improvement initiatives to management.

Your qualifications

• 
Experience within information security, compliance, IT risk or audit.

• 
Experience working with security controls, audits or assurance frameworks.

• 
Good understanding of information security and technology.

• 
Strong organisational and documentation skills.

• 
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• 
A proactive and pragmatic approach to problem solving.

• 
Experience from fintech, payments, SaaS, financial services or a similar environment is an advantage.

Experience with frameworks such as ISAE 3402, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar is an advantage.

You do not necessarily need to be able to answer yes to all of the above to be considered for the position.

Why work at Loyalty Key

• 
An exciting role with a varied workday and a high degree of responsibility.

• 
A dynamic and inspiring workplace with dedicated colleagues.

• 
An informal and supportive work environment where your ideas and initiatives are valued.

• 
Opportunities for both professional and personal development.

• 
Salary according to qualifications, health insurance and attractive benefits.

• 
The opportunity to shape how we work with information security, risk and compliance as the company grows.

• 
Lots of social events, Friday bars and opportunities to celebrate our successes together.

Start date and location

Start date by agreement.

Address: Dampfærgevej 21, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

Do you have any questions?

For further information, please contact Aaron Morley at aam@loyaltykey.com.

We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us a motivated application, your CV and any other relevant documents as soon as possible.

Medical Officer, HR – Help safeguard health and wellbeing across our Danish operations

Application deadline: Apply as soon as possible, as interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Contract type: Permanent, full-time

Job location: Esbjerg, with collaboration across onshore and offshore operations

Appetizer

Are you ready to use your medical expertise to make a meaningful impact on people’s health, safety, and wellbeing? Would you like to take on a central advisory role where you help strengthen occupational health, support safe energy operations, and contribute to business continuity both onshore and offshore?

As Medical Officer, you will be a trusted point of contact for health and medical management across TotalEnergies EP Denmark, working closely with HR, HSSE, offshore teams, contractors, headquarters medical specialists, and external stakeholders.

If you are motivated by combining medical knowledge with stakeholder collaboration, proactive health management, and the opportunity to help protect and support our workforce, we encourage you to apply for this role.

Activities

Key responsibilities

As Medical Officer, you will be responsible for medical oversight and health management across TotalEnergies EP Denmark’s onshore and offshore activities. Your responsibilities will include:

• Medical governance and advisory support: Act as point of contact for the headquarters Medical Department, support TotalEnergies EP Denmark contract owners, advise on offshore medical service delivery, and provide medical oversight, expertise, and leadership across onshore and offshore medical provisions.

• Occupational health and absence management: Manage sickness absence, case reviews, return-to-work planning, workplace adaptations, and verification of offshore medical certificates for personnel travelling to worksites.

• Health risk, wellbeing, and business continuity: Monitor health concerns and pandemics, maintain site health risk assessments, promote healthy lifestyles, support wellbeing initiatives, and help minimize operational disruption.

• Compliance, standards, and health surveillance: Support health programs in line with country regulations, TotalEnergies standards, and relevant international standards, and conduct occupational health surveillance data analysis.

• Service and insurance oversight: Investigate medical service complaints or deviations, consult headquarters for medical expertise, and support HR on workforce medical insurance.

• Industrial hygiene and drug testing: Advise within industrial hygiene, support compliance, plan site audits, and manage the company’s Drug and Alcohol Policy and related testing.

• Stakeholder collaboration: Build strong relationships with HR, HSSE, offshore teams, contractors, medical service providers, government health authorities, and relevant Danish offshore committees.

Personal development opportunities

• Shape and develop a central medical advisory role with influence across onshore and offshore operations

• Develop your expertise within occupational health, offshore medical governance, sickness absence management, and business continuity planning

• Gain broad exposure to HR, HSSE, offshore medical services, and external health authority collaboration

• Contribute to health promotion, wellbeing initiatives, and continuous improvement of medical processes and procedures

• Play an important part in safeguarding workforce health, safety, welfare, and operational resilience

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 753,000 – 1,004,000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

Candidate Profile

What we are looking for in a candidate

• Authorization to practice medicine in Denmark

• Experience as a medical doctor in emergency medicine, general medicine, an emergency department, or prehospital emergency medicine beyond student level

• Strong understanding of occupational health, medical governance, sickness absence management, and return-to-work processes

• Ability to advise on offshore medicals, fit-to-return medicals, workplace adaptations, and health risk assessments

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders

• Knowledge of the oil and gas industry is an advantage

• Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) registration as a doctor, or willingness to become certified

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement, as diverse experiences and perspectives strengthen our team

Additional background and experience

• Experience with occupational health surveillance, medical case reviews, and sickness absence case management

• Ability to work with offshore medical certificate standards such as Offshore Energies UK (OEUK) and the Danish Offshore Medical Certificate (DANOP) including fitness to work offshore

• Knowledge of industrial hygiene, health risk assessments, wellbeing programs, pandemic preparedness, food safety, mental health, and epidemic control is an advantage

• Experience from the oil and gas industry is a plus

TEST

Throughout your career, you will benefit from a wide variety of assignments and tailored learning opportunities. You will fully develop your potential in an environment that fosters innovation and excellence. Join committed and collaborative teams where success is built together.

jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:
• A MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related filed.
• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.
• Proven experience in data analytics, machine learning, and optimisation.
• Ability to program using Python, R, MATLAB or similar platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.It is considered an advantage if you have:
• Knowledge of animal heat stress and animal welfare.
• Knowledge of Large Language Model, stochastic modelling, system identification.
• Experience with CFD simulations.
Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering, Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Li Rong, e-mail: li.rong@cae.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Assistant Professor Tao Huang, e-mail: taoh@cae.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 30 November 2026 23:59 CET.
Preferred starting date is 1 February 2027.

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for an Analyst to join our Global Rewards team based in Copenhagen.

As a trusted partner to senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization, the team develops scalable and market-leading reward solutions that enable us to attract, retain, and motivate top talent globally.

As our Student Analyst, you will support incentives activities across multiple countries on both operational and strategic initiatives.

The position is part-time (around 20 hours per week) and based in our headquarters in NordØ. The workload will vary depending on ongoing projects, with flexibility to structure your time according to your schedule.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• Support onboarding new employees in our Long-Term Programs, i.e. handling and sending out Transfer Notes, Shareholder Agreements, Tax Side Letters to our employees and provide overall legal information of the content such as leaver terms, vesting conditions and maintaining all relevant data in our systems.

You

Having relevant experience is beneficial.

• Highly detail-oriented and structured in your approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy. You handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism, discretion, and integrity.

• You are confident using PowerPoint to transform data and insights into clear and impactful presentations for a range of stakeholders and have good Excel skills.

• Professional written and verbal communication skills in English, enabling you to communicate effectively and build strong relationships with stakeholders across a global organization.

Please note that we do not offer a remote working opportunity, thus you must be a Danish resident or an upcoming student enrolled in a Danish university to be eligible for this role. Students on exchange in Denmark are not considered eligible for this position.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

Building value that matters

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English

Please note:
You must be an EU/EEA citizen. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply.

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

Qtechnology is a leading innovator in smart camera technology, specializing in cutting-edge solutions for industrial vision and research and development (R&D). jobs.occupation: Section Manager for Wastewater Treatment Plants
jobs.description:
At Novafos, we are everyday heroes in water management—delivering clean drinking water to taps, managing rainwater in urban areas, and returning treated wastewater to the natural environment. We are approximately 400 dedicated employees who work every day to create solutions where society and the environment can thrive side by side.

Novafos are now seeking a Section Manager for Project 1 (Wastewater Treatment Plants) who will act as the driving force behind a highly skilled project team and ensure sustainable solutions across our facilities.

A role with responsibility, professionalism, and development

As Section Manager for Project 1, you will be responsible for a specialized team of 11 project managers working with the operation, maintenance, and renewal of Novafos’ existing wastewater treatment plants. Part of the team also contributes to the preparation of future water resource centers, which will gradually replace the current facilities—an important step in realizing Novafos’ long-term strategy.

You will have overall responsibility for the team’s project portfolio, ensuring progress, effective resource prioritization, and robust processes so that projects are successfully transitioned into operations. At the same time, you will serve as a key sparring partner, supporting both the professional and personal development of your team members.

You will be part of the management group, contributing to well-being, culture, and strategic development across the organization. In close collaboration with fellow managers, you will also help prepare and report on investment agreements to our nine owner municipalities.

Your leadership style

They are looking for a leader who delivers results through others—someone who can unite a team around shared goals and strike a balance between clear direction and autonomy.

As a leader, we expect you to:

• Be credible, clear, and inclusive

• Communicate effectively and provide constructive feedback

• Work in a goal-oriented and structured manner while remaining open to new ways of collaboration

Your responsibilities

As Section Manager, you will be the driving force behind the team’s success. Your tasks will include:

• Leading and developing your team and strengthening cross-functional collaboration

• Managing the project portfolio with a focus on time, budget, and quality

• Acting as a professional sparring partner for both experienced and junior employees

• Contributing to tender processes, investment agreements, and collaboration with consultants and contractors

Your background

They expect you to have a technical education, such as an engineering degree or a marine engineering qualification, along with several years of management experience—preferably as a Project Director or Team Manager. You have experience with project portfolio management, resource planning, and budget responsibility.

Experience with construction and utility projects—particularly wastewater treatment plants—is a strong advantage. Familiarity with procurement processes and collaboration with consultants and contractors will further strengthen your profile.

Work-life balance

At Novafos, we believe that a healthy balance between work and personal life is essential for well-being and job satisfaction. We respect your working hours and prioritize a safe and stable working environment.

In addition, we offer:

• Flexible working hours and a 37-hour workweek, including lunch

• The option to work from home 1–2 days per week

• Support for your professional development through courses and education

• Modern office and parking facilities at Blokken 9 in Birkerød

• Access to a canteen, fitness center, massage scheme, health insurance, and social events

Application

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and help develop the wastewater treatment plants of the future while ensuring sustainable solutions for Novafos? Then submit your application today!

This recruitment process is managed by Capax Recruitment. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Specialist Marianne Petersen at mkp@capax.dk.

Applications are accepted only via the specified application link. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.
